# M2 narrative gates — MAJOR STORY SPOILERS

Advisory companion to [M2 direction](../M2-DIRECTION-PROPOSAL.md), 2026-10-18. Read only for root/lore/world integration. This proposes implementation gates under the existing [canon](../../../spoilers/NARRATIVE_CANON.md); it changes neither canon nor current production. Keep this content out of ordinary owner-facing summaries, objective names, PR descriptions and unlabelled evidence.

**M2 must resolve the rescue, not stop at a reveal.** Both fleet strategies must support the same causal procedure, meaningful ending interaction and short resolution scene. M3 deepens voices, scenes and corroborating exploration; it cannot postpone the 191 survivors' rescue or replace it with “campaign coming soon.”

| Persistent content | M2 functional obligation | Full M3 treatment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arrival and injury | C01 hardware and C07 dock evidence agree with upward launch; C14 dispatch buffer explains elapsed time and regulator injury. Retain the brief playable pod opening. No spacecraft crash or deliberate memory erasure. | Authored opening motion/audio and partial, context-aware recollection; no convenient complete memory reset. |
| Population evidence | C05 inward movement, C08 transfer accounting and C10 medical protocol independently support C13 living-bed observation. Record early C13 immediately and change the question to preparation; do not require earlier clue collection to believe it. | All independent sources/optional perspectives and robust local redundant records; test comprehension without relying on a single log. |
| Ren's role and the gate | C05 separate witness account, C07/C08 tool-seal evidence and C09 authenticated order support responsibility. Present the crushed outer lock and non-traversable hydraulic schematic before using the final recording to explain the constraint. | Full C12 pressure trace, attempted alternative and final calls; grief/accusation remain legitimate. A duplicate recording is redundancy, not an independent witness. |
| Physical cause | C02/C04 present ecological observations agree with implemented fan/fauna behavior; C06/C11 dates and profiles support the extraction–slope–brine chain. | More authored observations and Mara's revised account, preserving uncertainty about motives rather than physical contradictions. |
| Ending | Reachable local controller/schematic supplies essential procedure and factual recovery summary, independently of C12/C15 personal playback. Player restores habitation and power/air, opens the safe route, performs supervised first awakening and sees confirmation of completed revival. | Contextual character scene, lookout, human presence and ending variation; optional exploration remains. |

Use a small authored facility state graph, not a general quest engine or simulated colony. The following names are internal design labels, never spoiler-bearing early objectives:

1. **Works reached:** exterior broad approach/service ledge both terminate outside the rated internal boundary. The hydraulic pipe is a fluid-service connection, never a human shortcut. Physical solids, schematic and interactions must agree.
2. **Independent support staged:** accept the prepared air/power assembly at its real interface; validate paid items, placement and capacity atomically. Ordinary District service-stop air/charging does not satisfy this separate requirement. No mandatory carrier or optional log predicate.
3. **Diversion isolated → equalization complete:** independent support permits isolating the still-active turbine diversion and slowly equalizing the now-empty compartments through the hydraulic pipe. Show actual supply/pressure indicators and authored transition progress. Refuse unsafe opening with one actionable reason; interruption/pause/reload preserves legal committed state without consuming parts twice.
4. **Human route opened; habitation ready:** independently validate the restored upper living area, dependable air/power and safe refuge access. Habitation work and exterior investigation may happen in either order; the opening procedure still respects the physical dependency. No survivor wakes into an uninhabitable area.
5. **Supervised revival → epilogue complete:** the controller offers a medically safe default without C15, optionally permitting another medically cleared candidate. Stage one meaningful awakening/contact, then a time cut and roster confirm all 191 awaken. Communal stores/food-production equipment suffice; no 191-meal/room grind. Credits resolve rescue, and exploration can continue.

Persist irreversible repairs, paid assembly placement, legal machinery phase and ending completion outside region lifetimes. Keep observations with stable source/provenance; derive interpretation from the full accumulated fact set rather than one saved “act” counter. Essential physical observations and local durable duplicates must converge on the same fact without claiming independent witnesses. Discovery through any actually visible remote camera is retained; Bobbin still cannot operate story machinery or replace the suited passenger expedition.

**Chronology/accounting invariants:** 218 arrivals; 20 initial deaths; 198 refuge arrivals; six workers die outside; 192 enter suspension including Ren; Ren launches seven years four months later; 191 remain to revive; 26 casualties stay dead. There is no hidden campaign countdown, alien collective mind, deceptive omniscient controller or resurrection. Present preparation removes the historical reserve constraint because compartments are empty and independent support exists; it does not prove the six had an overlooked escape or resolve whether Ren waited long enough. C15 remains optional emotional context, never a permission flag.

Before M2 acceptance, both complete strategies must pass early-C13 discovery, missed C12/C15 playback, out-of-order C05/C08/C09, local redundant-evidence recovery, incapacitation, region unload/re-entry and save/reload at every machinery commit. Attempt opening without independent support/equalization and revival without habitation; refusals preserve resources/state. Repeated commands and interrupted ending entry cannot duplicate consumption or reset completed repairs. Restore safe control/survival handling around authored scenes. Label seeded transition probes separately from ordinary New Game→ending evidence. M3 then validates the full clue/foreshadow/voice treatment with the same paired gate and its experience review.
